notes.title: 1.03, The Last Update.
notes.notes:
Based on feedback and watching some play sessions, I've addressed some finnicky things during combat, Input, and the camera system.

This will also be my last update on the game, at least on my immediate plans. If harsh things come up again, I'll look into doing a patch at least a year down the line. I will be moving on to other works, so I hope you enjoy my completed version of "Shrine Of The Forest God"

Thank you all for playing my freshman game, and I hope you enjoyed this experience.
